MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.

   D. Any white crystal used in cooking
